snippet.title: Sanctuary of Small Things - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The small creatures of this world are falling sick. You have been pulled 
from your own world by a ball of light to rescue them, armed with a gentle 
spell, a tended garden, and a bubbling cauldron.

🌱 WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4813510/Sanctuary_of_Small_Things/

A cozy creature-rescue sim about kindness, and the quiet joy of making 
small things feel better.

🐉 Rescue sick creatures with the Safekeep spell
🌧️ Grow your garden and call the rain with Bloomcall
🧪 Brew cures at the alchemy table
🪓 Gather, smelt, and craft everything by hand
👒 Create your own keeper
🤝 Play solo or co-op with up to four friends

From Little Limp Games — a solo developer building a small, kind world.

#cozygames #indiegames #cozygaming
